subject: Billing handoff & payor switch for upcoming renewal — documents and PO
messages:
From: Eve Lin <eve.lin@greenbridge.ai>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 12 Sep 2027 09:22:00 -0700
Subject: Billing handoff & payor switch for upcoming renewal — PO attached

Hi Naomi,

As we close in on our renewal next month, GreenBridge is finalizing the internal purchasing flow. Two quick asks so we can lock the order today: 

1) Attached is the formal PO (GreenBridge_PO_78921.pdf). Please confirm the billing entity and payor name you want printed on the invoice. Our procurement system requires an exact legal name and EIN.

2) Our finance team requires an issued W-8BEN-E on file for the vendor paying from our international subsidiary (we'll attach once signed). Can you confirm the person at Redwood who should receive the signed W-8 and the email for secure upload?

We are also planning a small capacity bump (+20% GPU hours) for Q4 under the same committed amount; we'd like that to be captured in an addendum rather than a new contract, and prefer Net45 payment terms. If there are internal approval steps on your side for the payor switch, flag them so we can align timelines.

Thanks — looking to close this today if possible.

Best,
Eve Lin
Senior Procurement Manager
GreenBridge, Inc.
Attachments: GreenBridge_PO_78921.pdf
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>
To: Eve Lin <eve.lin@greenbridge.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 13 Sep 2027 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Billing handoff & payor switch for upcoming renewal — PO attached

Eve — thanks for the PO and the context. Quick responses below and next steps: 

- Billing entity: Please have invoices addressed to "GreenBridge, Inc. (US Payor Entity)" with EIN 12-3456789. If your payor is the EU subsidiary, we need the exact legal entity name and VAT ID —let us know which entity will remit payment.

- W-8 handling: We cannot accept the W-8 via regular email for security. Please upload the signed W-8BEN-E to our secure intake portal (Doc link below). Once uploaded, I will route to finance for PO matching. Contact for secure upload: finance-intake@redwood.ai (this mailbox is monitored by our billing ops team).

- Addendum for capacity bump: We can do an addendum that increments committed capacity by 20% for Q4 and keeps the same term length. I attached a short redline (redwood_capacity_addendum_v2.docx) — the main change will be the capacity tables and payment schedule. We normally default to Net30; moving to Net45 can be approved by Finance but will require a credit check step. Please confirm if GreenBridge needs Net45 as a must-have or a preference.

Next actions:
- Eve: upload signed W-8 to secure portal and confirm which legal entity will be the payor.
- GreenBridge Finance: confirm Net45 requirement.
- Naomi/Marissa: we'll initiate an expedited credit check if Net45 is requested.

I'll loop in billing-ops if we get the upload.

Naomi Feldman
Director, Sales Operations
Redwood Inference
Attachments: redwood_capacity_addendum_v2.docx
Links: https://www.docusign.com/en/agreements/DS-abcdef123456
From: Eve Lin <eve.lin@greenbridge.ai>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>
Cc: GreenBridge Finance <finance@greenbridge.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2027 16:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Billing handoff & payor switch for upcoming renewal — PO attached

Thanks Naomi — quick update after internal check: 

- Payor: GreenBridge, Inc. (US Payor Entity) will be remitting. Use EIN 12-3456789 as you suggested.
- W-8: attached signed W-8BEN-E_GreenBridge_signed.pdf; I uploaded a copy to your DocuSign intake link and also attached here per your upload guidance.
- Terms: Net45 is required by our FP&A team for this commit. Please proceed with the credit check; we can accept a brief hold on provisioning if needed.

We are good to accept the addendum language in redwood_capacity_addendum_v2.docx. Once finance confirms on Redwood's end, we'll sign and route the PO. 

Final ask: please confirm the billing contact and the invoice email to include on the PO so our AP system will match correctly (many systems require exact strings).

Appreciate the fast turnaround — Eve

--
Eve Lin
Senior Procurement Manager
GreenBridge, Inc.
Attachments: W-8BEN-E_GreenBridge_signed.pdf, GreenBridge_PO_78921.pdf
